title: Learn Probe Task Set
description: A set of tasks a probe can run against. Every task carries an objectively checkable answer; there is no LLM judge.

id.description: Stable task identifier; part of the probe id.

kind.description: deterministic needs 1 seed per arm; stochastic needs at least 3.

prompt.description: The task as the agent receives it, including the required answer format.

file.description: Repository-relative path the answer must name.

symbol.description: Exported symbol the answer must name.

goldArtifacts.description: Repository-relative paths containing the answer key. Each is removed from every arm's worktree and the removal is verified before the turn starts.
